short: 3D-conv + ResNet + Bi-LSTM (M06), which became the field default, and per-step training (M03) are standard only for lack of run counts; 83.0% trails audio-supervised 93.2% today.
position: The paper [@stafylakis2017resnetlstm] changes the processing chain (M06), one 3D convolution layer, a per-frame ResNet-34 and a two-layer Bi-LSTM, and the training recipe (M03), three stages with the word loss at every time step. Both are standard solely because no run count or dispersion is reported (§4.5), which ahead requires; nothing can be behind, as the LRW benchmark [@chung2016lrw] is [concurrent] and the ledger holds 0 prior LRW keys (Appendix). The M06 design descends from this paper: 0 of 4 [concurrent] LRW keys name a ResNet; 106 of 156 keys now name 3D convolution and a ResNet (upper bound; Appendix). The 6.8-point margin over WAS [@chung2017was] [concurrent] is one cross-system comparison with no run count; WAS's extra BBC pretraining favours the comparator. Today 83.0% sits 10.2 points below SyncVSR [@ahn2024syncvsr] [later], which is trained with quantized-audio targets, so the gap mixes architecture with audio supervision (inference).
